text:
Ben L: Sunup handoff for my 08:00-16:00 shift. No active incidents. Quick notes below, nothing blocking.

Ben L: What changed since last night:
- Rolled canary of model v3.5-small to 10% traffic in us-west at 03:12. Latency looks fine so far, a small spike at 03:20 (~40ms p95 bump) but back to baseline.
- Enabled debug-level logs for kv-cache in prod for 2h window to capture a weird miss pattern. Expect more log noise.
- Autoscaler policy tweak: scaleDownCooldown set to 90s in staging -> scheduled to sync to prod at 10:00 if nothing odd.

Ben L: Watchlist:
- kv-cache miss rate in us-west (metric: cache.hit_rate). If hit_rate drops below 92% for >5m, that's our signal to revert the kv debug toggle.
- Canary latency tail for v3.5-small: p95 > 450ms => rollback.
- Pod OOMs on batch-workers-2 (recent spike on node gpu-10).

Maya R: pinging on the canary — rough numbers in grafana look good from my end. saw the 03:20 wobble but trace sampling shows it was a backend kernel load. will keep an eye. :eyes:

Priya S: quick FYI — alert noise from debug kv logs will hit our alert pipeline. I've bumped the dedupe window for the logging rule to 5m to avoid flooding pager, but still configured a critical rule to fire if error_rate > 0.5%

Sam T: PR ping: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/5823 needs an approval (autoscaler policy change + unit test). It's small but blocks the prod sync at 10:00. @Ben L can you take a look before 09:30?

Ben L: looking now — will either approve or leave comments in next 20m.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: autoscaler-policy-sync -> prod at 10:00 UTC (triggered by pipeline #2107). Rolling update, 5% steps, 2m interval.

Ben L: Action items for this shift:
- (Ben L) Review/approve PR 5823 by 09:30.
- (Maya R) Keep canary watch for v3.5-small for first 2 hours. Post any p95 regressions to thread.
- (Priya S) Monitor logging alert queue; escalate if dedupe doesn't hold.
- (Sam T) Standby to revert kv debug toggle if miss_rate trend persists.

Priya S: calendar note — I'm offline 12:30-13:30 for lunch. reachable on DM for critical stuff.

Ben L: small ops note — if you see batch-worker pods triggering OOM on gpu-10, scale that node group to +1 as a quick mitigation and open a ticket to investigate mem usage.

Maya R: TL;DR: no incidents, canary live, watch kv-cache & pod OOMs, PR blocks autoscaler sync.

oncall-bot: Alert summary (last 6h): 3 warnings (kv-cache miss spike x2, node cpu saturation x1), 0 critical.

Sam T: acked. I can take the node scale if it happens.

Ben L: Thanks team. I'll post an update after the 10:00 sync and again at 12:00. Ping @here for anything immediate. :thumbsup:

Maya R: thanks — will report back with any canary anomalies.

[end of thread]
